items.name: deep-research-web-ui
items.description: AI deep-research agent that turns any question into a cited report: plans searches, reads real sources, verifies evidence. Self-hosted, multi-provider, Docker-ready.

items.name: firecrawl-claude-plugin
items.description: Firecrawl plugin for Claude Code: search the live web, developer docs, government sources and research papers, run structured data providers, and scrape a page into clean Markdown. Firecrawl is the context API for AI agents.

items.name: agentic-rag-paper-assistant
items.description: Agentic RAG research paper reading assistant with PDF ingestion, pgvector retrieval, LangGraph workflow, streaming chat, evidence sources, and OpenAlex/web search integration.

items.name: localharness
items.description: An open-source, coding agent harness designed specifically for local LLMs. Designed as everything a user needs to jumpstart their own harness (detailed event steams, logs, and performance data)  or quickly replace closed source one (featuring out of the box plugins for web search, image gen, memory, auto research and more in dev).
